sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me look at the full segmentation to find any special markers
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("All nodes:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] > 5:
        print(f"  id={n['id']}, color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary'][:4]}...")

# Let me also check the ASCII around the top of the channels to see if there are target markers
lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\nTop of left channel (rows 24-38):")
for r in range(24, 39):
    row_str = lines[r] if r < len(lines) else ''
    crop = row_str[8:29]
    if 'S' in crop or 'g' in crop or 'w' in crop or 'P' in crop or 'M' in crop:
        print(f"  {r:2d}: {crop}")

print("\nTop of right channel (rows 29-43):")
for r in range(29, 44):
    row_str = lines[r] if r < len(lines) else ''
    crop = row_str[32:54]
    if 'S' in crop or 'g' in crop or 'w' in crop or 'P' in crop or 'M' in crop:
        print(f"  {r:2d}: {crop}")

# Try moving left square all the way left and right to find limits
result = action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nAfter 3x LEFT:")
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'S':
        print(f"  Blue id={n['id']}, boundary={n['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
